pending.title: The Superpower in Your Fingertips
pending.hook: An Earth-sized finger could feel houses and cars
pending.narration: An Earth-sized finger could feel houses and cars. Our fingertips are highly sensitive. Scientists found we can feel tiny ridges only thirteen nanometers high. That is smaller than a single cell. If your finger was as big as the whole Earth, your skin could easily feel the bump of a small home or a parked car. It is like super strength for touch. Hit follow for more.
pending.caption:
I can't look at my own hands the same way after learning this.

Scientists in Sweden actually proved this back in 2013. They discovered our fingertips can sense microscopic ridges that are only 13 nanometers high. To put that in perspective, a single strand of human hair is about 80,000 nanometers wide. So if your finger was scaled up to the size of our entire planet, you would easily feel the texture difference between a suburban home and a sedan. Honestly, our sense of touch is totally underrated 🌎

What is the weirdest texture you have ever felt?
